what: RTL simulation (Icarus Verilog) of tb/tb_psd_top.v and tb/tb_bispectrum_top.v for the configurations of python/scripts/run_rtl_matrix.py; the Python model only supplies the expected values
simulator: Icarus Verilog, apt package of the ubuntu-latest runner (version not printed in the log)

columns.round: RTL parameter ROUND (1: round half up, 0: truncate)
columns.squarer: serial sum-of-odds squarer or multiplier (RTL parameter SQ_SERIAL; psd only)
columns.segments: PSD segments or bispectrum frames of the vectors
columns.words_checked: result words compared with the model: 1024 PSD bins, or 32 x 32 bispectrum bins (real and imaginary part compared together)
columns.model_clamped_diffs: rounded butterfly differences that the model's clamp changed while building the vectors (reachable only with rounding)
